rv.q: It’s enormous fun to watch, and you have to take your hat off to its ambition.
It’s a bittersweet story, and another roaring success for Pitlochry Festival Theatre.

cn.t: Simon Russell Beale delivers showy bravura in this well-received production about Liberace's infamous libel trial, with critics praising Tim Hatley's award-worthy designs and the play's bold theatrical approach to the flamboyant entertainer's story.
